plan.notes: Source: Northeast Community College official program sheet 'Nursing: Pre-Professional AS, AA' (https://northeast.edu/_documents/programs/nursing-pre-professional-as-aa.pdf), 'Suggested Pathway of Study for Associate of Arts Degree (2 years)' (right column). Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Prepares for admission to a practical nursing or ADN program; coursework may transfer toward a BSN. Catalog total 63-66; ranges resolved to minimums (Electives 3, Fine Arts 3), yielding 63. Generic categories modeled as ELECTIVE-n choice slots. Recommended electives per catalog: BIOS 2260, BIOS 2460, HLTH 1060, NURA 1110, PSYC 2200, NURS 2100, MATH 2170 — see program advisor. Students with appropriate placement scores are not required to take BIOS 1010 prior to BIOS 2250 or BIOS 2460. Per-course prerequisites are not listed on the program sheet; see https://northeast.edu/catalog. '*' marks gen-ed courses.
